title: Fluid.Work
meta: Logo, brand identity, marketing assets, website design

body.p: Fluidwork Business Solution UK offers project and programme management: it helps teams with a shared purpose work together in meetings, projects and everyday team activity.

A friend introduced me to Dan Justin, Fluidwork's CEO. In our first ten-minute call Dan explained what he wanted: to rebrand the company, with an identity that flows the way the name suggests. The work grew from there, from the logo to the whole identity, the marketing assets and the website.

We started with the logo and explored several directions, from flowing, curved forms to a sharper, geometric F. Each was tested in colour, in white on the dark brand navy, and inside a roundel for app and social icons.
By the second day the exploration had narrowed to three options. Dan shared them with his team, they chose one unanimously, and that mark became the base for everything that followed.
The identity takes its cues from minimalism: ideas reduced to their essential parts, with clean shapes, modern type and a small, confident palette.

body.quote: Our company brand is our identity. Gokul went above and beyond the usual to understand us and help us build a brand that represents us and is unique. Great working with him.
